name: Five-condition pivot reversal bar
note: A demand pivot (fractal low, half-width fw) is broken, then reclaimed within gap bars by a single bar satisfying all five conditions at once: close above the two prior closes, close back above the broken pivot low, close above its own open, close above the midq fraction of its own range, and a range larger than the previous bar's. Short is the exact mirror around a broken supply pivot. The signal is emitted on the reversal bar's close so the shared harness fills at the NEXT open, which is the entry the source specifies.
source: https://oxfordstrat.com/trading-strategies/reversal-patterns-part-2/ -- top/bottom reversal around supply/demand pivots: closes beyond the two previous closings, close beyond the pivot, close beyond the opening and the mid-range of the day, daily range exceeding the previous day's range, all within 5 bars of the breakout; entry at the open after the reversal; rating C, 42 US futures markets 1980-2011. Pivot construction follows Kaufman's swing-point definition.
code:
def family_init(ctx):
    bars = ctx.bars
    N = len(bars)
    o = [float(b["o"]) for b in bars]
    h = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    l = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    fw = max(1, int(ctx.p.fw))
    gap = max(0, int(ctx.p.gap))
    q = float(ctx.p.midq)

    sig = [0] * N
    pl = None
    ph = None
    bdl = -1
    bdh = -1
    start = 2 * fw + 2
    for i in range(start, N):
        p = i - fw
        lo0 = l[p]
        hi0 = h[p]
        okl = True
        okh = True
        for k in range(1, fw + 1):
            if okl and not (lo0 < l[p - k] and lo0 < l[p + k]):
                okl = False
            if okh and not (hi0 > h[p - k] and hi0 > h[p + k]):
                okh = False
            if not okl and not okh:
                break
        if okl:
            pl = lo0
            bdl = -1
        if okh:
            ph = hi0
            bdh = -1

        if pl is not None and bdl < 0 and l[i] < pl:
            bdl = i
        if ph is not None and bdh < 0 and h[i] > ph:
            bdh = i

        s = 0
        if bdl >= 0:
            if i - bdl > gap:
                bdl = -1
            else:
                rng = h[i] - l[i]
                pr = h[i - 1] - l[i - 1]
                if (c[i] > c[i - 1] and c[i] > c[i - 2] and c[i] > pl
                        and c[i] > o[i] and rng > pr
                        and c[i] >= l[i] + q * rng):
                    s = 1
                    bdl = -1
                    pl = None
        if s == 0 and bdh >= 0:
            if i - bdh > gap:
                bdh = -1
            else:
                rng = h[i] - l[i]
                pr = h[i - 1] - l[i - 1]
                if (c[i] < c[i - 1] and c[i] < c[i - 2] and c[i] < ph
                        and c[i] < o[i] and rng > pr
                        and c[i] <= h[i] - q * rng):
                    s = -1
                    bdh = -1
                    ph = None
        sig[i] = s
    ctx.sg = ctx.series(sig, "reversal_bar")


def signal(ctx, i):
    s = ctx.sg[i]
    return s if s else 0
